subject: DuxBio bake-off: request to realign evaluation credit split and short extension
messages:
From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@duxbio.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>; procurement@duxbio.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: DuxBio bake-off: credit ask and competitor parity

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency profile. We're running a tight bake-off next week against OrchardAI and they've offered an extra 750k token credit and a dedicated engineer for two weeks.

To keep the comparison level, procurement asked whether Redwood can realign the evaluation credit pool: specifically, could we move 500k tokens from the standard trial pool into an accelerated bake-off tranche (isolated, expires 30 days from activation) and extend the evaluation window by 10 days? Our timeline: kickoff on Monday 6/16, results due 6/30.

If you can confirm today we can include Redwood in the exec decision round.

Attachments: bakeoff-requirements.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Cole
Head of Integrations, DuxBio
evancole@duxbio.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@duxbio.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DuxBio bake-off: credit ask and competitor parity

Evan — appreciate the quick follow.

We can support an isolated tranche and a short extension in principle, but that requires a one-time adjustment to the eval credit allocation and an approval from sales ops for the accelerated pool. I want to be transparent: our standard trial policy doesn't routinely extend windows beyond 21 days without an exception, and isolated token pools are gated for cost control.

I'll escalate to Sales Ops and Jordan for approval. Can you confirm the absolute max tokens you'd like in the tranche (500k is fine to propose) and whether the engineer support is procurement-only (i.e., we don't need an integration SLA to enable it)? That helps the ops ask.

Proposed next steps:
- I’ll circulate an internal approval request with a credit-realignment proposal (will attach a breakdown).
- If approved, we’ll send a formal DocuSign sheet for the one-time trial addendum.

Soojin
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Life Sciences
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: DuxBio bake-off — request for credit realignment and short extension (DUX-2025-043)

Neha / Jordan,

Heads-up: DuxBio wants us to reallocate 500k tokens from the account's existing sandbox into an "accelerated bake-off tranche" that expires 30 days after activation, plus a 10-day extension on the evaluation window. They cited a competitive offer (OrchardAI) that includes an extra credit bucket and some embedded engineering support.

Why this is time-sensitive: kickoff Monday 6/16. If we can't match parity today, they may not include Redwood in the final side-by-side. The ARR upside is mid-six figures if we win.

Proposed conservative option (favored):
- Move 350k tokens into isolated tranche (isolated usage only, cannot be reallocated back).
- Grant a 7-day extension to the evaluation window (instead of 10).
- Require procurement signature on a one-off trial addendum and mark the deal with a trial exception flag in HubSpot.

If we need to be more aggressive to win, Option B: 500k tranche + 10-day extension but requires Jordan sign-off for credit exception and a one-off promo code to track cost.

Attachments: duxbio-credit-proposal-v2.pdf (pdf), bakeoff-scope.xlsx (xls)

Can you confirm whether Sales Ops can approve Option A today? If not, Jordan — can you sign off on Option B?

Soojin
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 07:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: DuxBio bake-off — request for credit realignment and short extension (DUX-2025-043)

Soojin / Neha —

I reviewed the numbers (saw the proposal). Option A is approvable from a cost perspective: 350k isolated tranche + 7-day extension. Please note the following controls must be in place before activation:
1) The tranche must be tagged to DUX-2025-043 promo code so we can cost-center the usage.
2) Procurement must sign the trial addendum that includes the isolation and expiry date.
3) Security/compliance signoff: ask DuxBio to confirm no production PII will be included in the bake-off. If they will, we need a brief data handling attestation.

If Soojin thinks 350k won't be competitive we can push to 500k but that requires a small credit reserve transfer and explicit approval from Revenue Ops (I'll loop them if needed).

Jordan
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@duxbio.com>
Cc: procurement@duxbio.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DuxBio bake-off: credit ask and competitor parity

Evan — good news. We can proceed with a targeted credit tranche. Final terms below: 

- Isolated tranche: 350,000 tokens (isolated usage, expires 30 days after activation).
- Evaluation window: +7 days extension from original end date (noted in HubSpot).
- Activation: we’ll provision the tranche once we receive the signed trial addendum (DocuSign link below).
- Requirements: please confirm no production PII will be sent during the bake-off or provide the attestation form.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/abc-123-sign
Attachments: duxbio-credit-proposal-v2.pdf (pdf) — includes token tracking and promo code (DUX-TR-350)

If you need the extra 150k to match OrchardAI, I can request a supplemental approval but it will add a short delay while Revenue Ops confirms reserve availability. Otherwise, we’re set to activate on receipt of signed addendum.

Looking forward to the kickoff — we’ll stand up a dedicated monitoring dashboard for the tranche and share daily usage metrics.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive — Life Sciences
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
